title: EventEnvelope
description: The envelope that wraps every event ZippyGo publishes, whether delivered to a webhook endpoint or consumed from a stream. The business data lives in `payload`; its shape is defined per event type and version in the event catalog.

id.description: Unique identifier of this event, a UUID version 7 so that ids sort by creation time. Consumers use it to deduplicate redeliveries.

type.description: The event type as `<domain>.<event>` in lowercase snake_case, for example `order.placed`. The full list is in the event catalog.

version.description: The payload schema version for this event type. Changes within a version are additive; a breaking change to the payload is published as a new version.

occurred_at.description: When the event happened, as an RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC. Events may be delivered out of order; sort by this field when order matters.

partner_id.description: The partner the event belongs to, or `null` for platform-level events that are not scoped to a partner. Every domain event is scoped to exactly one partner.

correlation_id.description: A UUID shared by every event and request that stem from the same originating action, for tracing a flow end to end, or `null` when the event was not caused by a traceable request. Opaque to consumers.

payload.description: The event data. The schema is defined by `type` and `version` in the event catalog.
